rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a cannon-fired projectile, including an explosive shell.

example.traditional: 博物館展出咗一枚炮彈。
example.jyutping: bok3 mat6 gun2 zin2 ceot1 zo2 jat1 mui4 paau3 daan6

rows.note: Use this for jumping into a pool while holding the knees and making a large splash.

example.english: I did a cannonball into the pool and splashed water everywhere.
example.traditional: 我一跳落水就嚟個炮彈式跳水，搞到成池水都濺晒出嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 tiu3 lok6 seoi2 zau6 lai4 go3 paau3 daan6 sik1 tiu3 seoi2 gaau2 dou3 seng4 ci4 seoi2 dou1 zin3 saai3 ceot1 lei4

rows.note: Use this in sports for a very fast, flat serve with little or no arc.

example.english: This cannonball serve was so fast that the opponent couldn't return it.
example.traditional: 呢個炮彈式發球快到對手都接唔住。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 paau3 daan6 sik1 faat3 kau4 faai3 dou3 deoi3 sau2 dou1 zip3 m4 zyu6
